title: Steps to view credit card subscriptions

steps.text: Login to the mobile application, Land on cards dashboard page
Click on ‘My Subscriptions’ in the action board
View the subscriptions your card is currently linked to. If no active subscriptions, nothing will appear.
If you have active subscriptions, it will show. To view a subscription, click on it which will give you the merchants information
From the ‘Active’ subscriptions page, you can view each merchant, their information and stop payment for a set amount of time: 3 months, 6 months, 9 months.
From the main dashboard, you can view your stopped payments. This page will give you information about when you stopped payment and when the end date is.
You can remove stop payment as well. This will authorize the merchant to collect payment.
